description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers inpainting, background replacement, colour variation, object removal, and targeted render modification. Should-not covers near-miss neighbours: greenfield image generation (image-creator/image-generation), provider selection (image-provider-routing), prompt writing (image-creator), rights/licence check (media governance).

queries.q: edit the background of this product shot to a white studio setting
inpaint the logo out of the upper-right corner of this image
make a variation of this hero image in a warmer colour palette
remove the person standing on the left side of the photo
modify this existing render — I want the sky replaced with a sunset
generate a new product shot from scratch — I have no existing image
which image provider should I use for this job?
create a logo for my company
how do I write a good prompt for Ideogram?
do I need a rights check before using a celebrity's likeness in my image?
